title: 第九十一章大管事冯老第九十章我成香饽饽了
content_zh:
第九十一章，大管事，冯老！
“秦风已经醒了？？”
吴家大长老极其意外道，似乎不敢相信，秦风醒的如此之快。
毕竟，经历了那种级别的战斗，哪怕没有身负重伤，光是灵气恢复都需要很长一段时间，更何况其它内伤了。
“没错，才醒。”
“去把宁美管事和大管事带过来把，先别将秦风苏醒的事情说出去。”
“以免引起骚动。”
吴熵提醒道。
“明白了，家主。”
随着门外的脚步声离去，屋内三人也都陷入了沉默之中。
没过多久，脚步声再次响起，但却多了两道。
吴熵睁开眼睛，看着密室大门道：“来了，你还有什么需要准备的没？”
秦风知道这是在问自己，于是连忙回应道：“我没什么要准备的，又不是仇家寻仇。”
“哈哈哈！”
“那倒也是。”
“不过，我得提醒你，要是有机会能够加入四方商会的话，千万别拒绝。”
“虽然东土大陆明面上是人皇城最为强大，但实际上，四方商会才是最深不可测的。”
“你在龙家待了那么些年，应该也了解过吧？”
吴熵紧盯着秦风说道，似乎生怕后者不知道四方商会的恐怖。
“放心吧，吴家主。”

“晚辈知道该怎么做的。”
秦风点点头回应。
“爹，行了。”
“秦风又不是傻子，你怎么老是教他做事啊？”
“还把对我这一套用在人家身上？”
“他又不是你儿子。”
“哼！”
一旁的吴倩儿十分不满道。
“哈哈哈！老夫习惯了。”
吴熵笑呵呵道。
就在此时，门外响起了声音。
“家主，宁美管事和大管事都来了。”
吴家大长老的声音响起。
“好，本家主这就开门。”
吴熵回应后，立马施展手段，将这扇紧闭的密室大门给打开了。
很快，三道身影进入房间也映入了秦风眼帘。
宁美身穿火红长裙，胸前高峰伫立，一片雪白，加上其魔鬼身材，简直不要太勾人。
而在她身边却站着一位其貌不扬，甚至还有些丑陋的老者，这让秦风顿时有种巨大的反差感。
content_en:
Chapter 91: Chief Steward, Mr. Feng!
"Qin Feng is already awake??"
The eldest elder of the Wu family said in great surprise, as if he couldn't believe that Qin Feng woke up so quickly.
After all, after going through a battle of that level, even if you are not seriously injured, it will take a long time to recover your spiritual energy, not to mention other internal injuries.
"That's right, I just woke up."
"Go and bring Manager Ning Mei and the Chief Manager here. Don't tell anyone about Qin Feng's awakening yet."
"So as not to cause a commotion."
Wu Entropy reminded.
"I understand, Master."
As the footsteps outside the door left, the three people in the room fell into silence.
Not long after, footsteps sounded again, but there were two more.
Wu Entropy opened his eyes, looked at the door of the secret room and said, "Here we come, do you have anything else to prepare?"
Qin Feng knew that he was asking himself, so he quickly responded: "I have nothing to prepare, and it's not like my enemy is seeking revenge."
"Hahaha!"
"That's true."
"However, I have to remind you, if you have the opportunity to join the Sifang Chamber of Commerce, don't refuse."
"Although the Human Imperial City is the most powerful on the Eastern Earth Continent, in fact, the Sifang Chamber of Commerce is the most unfathomable."
"You have been in the Long family for so many years, so you should know about it, right?"
Wu Entropy stared at Qin Feng and said, as if he was afraid that the latter would not know the terror of the Sifang Chamber of Commerce.
"Don't worry, Master Wu."
"Junior knows what to do."
Qin Feng nodded in response.
"Dad, that's it."
"Qin Feng is not a fool, why do you always teach him how to do things?"
"You still use the same trick you did on me on others?"
"He is not your son."
"Hmph!"
Wu Qian'er on the side said very dissatisfied.
"Hahaha! I'm used to it."
Wu Entropy said with a smile.
At this moment, there was a sound outside the door.
"Master, Steward Ningmei and the Chief Steward are here."
The voice of the eldest elder of the Wu family sounded.
"Okay, my master will open the door right now."
After Wu Entropy responded, he immediately used his means to open the closed door to the secret room.
Soon, three figures entered the room and caught Qin Feng's eyes.
Ning Mei was wearing a fiery red dress, with her chest standing tall and white, and with her devilish figure, she was simply not too attractive.
But standing next to her was an old man who was unattractive and even somewhat ugly. This made Qin Feng feel a huge contrast.
